correctness.rationale: Expand (A+epsilon B)^d and identify the linearized operator. Each (a,b) Jordan-block map is multiplication by F_d=(x^d-y^d)/(x-y) modulo (x^a,y^b): (x-y)F_d=0 yields one surviving independent homogeneous image per degree d-1 through a+b-2, proving rank max(0,a+b-d) in all characteristics. Sum ordered pairs of blocks and multiply by the standard nilpotent GL_n orbit cardinality. The attached checker independently reconstructed block ranks and enumerated entire matrix pairs in six small prime-field cases. No finite test is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full Jordan-type point-count polynomial for finite-dual-number solutions of X^d=0, d>=3, is a natural complete invariant of bounded-nilpotence representation schemes. Unlike a routine isolated numeric calculation, the formula determines all strata for arbitrary dimension, nilpotency bound and field characteristic, including their characteristic-free deformation dimensions.
